screening_decisions.reason: This is a staging classification paper (revised FIGO staging), not an RCT comparing chemotherapy in advanced endometrial carcinoma.
Randomised trial comparing doxorubicin alone versus doxorubicin plus cyclophosphamide in advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
Phase III randomised trial comparing doxorubicin+cisplatin versus doxorubicin+paclitaxel+filgrastim in endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
This paper concerns standardized reporting guidelines for cancer treatment results, not a clinical trial of chemotherapy for endometrial cancer.
This study evaluates pelvic exenteration surgery for recurrent endometrial cancer, not chemotherapy.
Randomised trial (central office randomization) comparing adriamycin versus cyclophosphamide in patients with advanced endometrial cancer. Meets selection criteria.
Randomized phase II study comparing cisplatin alone versus CAP combination in progestin-refractory advanced endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
Randomised phase II study comparing cyclophosphamide versus ifosfamide in advanced and/or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
This is an overview of beta-blocker trials after myocardial infarction, unrelated to endometrial cancer chemotherapy.

Gynecologic Oncology Group study of multidrug treatment in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer with randomized assignment (except for 63 cardiac patients assigned to avoid adriamycin). Compares chemotherapy regimens. Meets selection criteria.
Methodological paper on extracting summary statistics for meta-analyses with survival endpoints, not a primary RCT.
Phase III trial randomly comparing MVAC versus AC chemotherapy in women with advanced primary or recurrent metastatic endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
Phase III trial comparing doxorubicin+cisplatin with or without paclitaxel+filgrastim in advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
This trial evaluates MIC chemotherapy in unresectable non-small cell lung cancer, not endometrial carcinoma.
The abstract describes an evaluation of three chemotherapy regimens but does not mention randomization; selection criteria require RCTs, so this is excluded.
Methodological paper on incorporating summary time-to-event data into meta-analysis, not a primary RCT of chemotherapy for endometrial cancer.
This appears to be a short commentary or review on changes in treatment without primary RCT data comparing chemotherapy regimens in advanced disease.
This concerns adjuvant chemotherapy after hysterectomy for endometrial cancer, which is explicitly excluded by the selection criteria.
This review evaluates hormonal therapy for advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer, not cytotoxic chemotherapy.
This is a general review on surgical management, staging, and lymphadenectomy for endometrial cancer, not an RCT comparing chemotherapy.
This is a retrospective cohort study describing patterns of treatment failure and survival, not an RCT comparing chemotherapy regimens.
Randomized phase III trial comparing standard timed versus circadian timed doxorubicin+cisplatin in stage III/IV or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
Phase III trial comparing doxorubicin alone versus doxorubicin+cisplatin in advanced endometrial carcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
Randomised study comparing doxorubicin alone versus doxorubicin+cisplatin in advanced and/or recurrent endometrial adenocarcinoma. Meets selection criteria.
